results.title: Malformed restored window record does not blank the desktop
Non-array recent-apps history does not crash the Dock or block launches
Malformed notification history entries do not crash the notification centre
Personal wallpaper data URL cannot inject extra CSS image layers
Retrying an app whose code chunk failed to load actually reloads it
A failed desktop (Shell) chunk shows a recovery path instead of a blank page
App cannot execute another window’s scoped commands or privileged shell commands
File access revoked in Settings is denied at operation time via the API
Notification storm from one app stays bounded and does not freeze the shell
Window-launch storm from one app is capped
App notifications are attributed so an app cannot impersonate the OS
Closed window context cannot open OS file dialogs or register commands
Spotlight keeps Tab focus inside the dialog for 25 presses
OS file dialog keeps Tab focus inside and Escape cancels it
Global shortcuts still work after launching an app from the Dock
PerfectHue credit is visible, unobstructed, and uses the manifest credit URL
